answers: The group aims to collect over 100 hours of Meeting Recorder data in total. Speaker consent forms are being revised. It was suggested that subjects should sign a new consent form after 10 recording sessions.

full.prediction: The future of data collection involves continuing to record meetings, aiming to accumulate significantly more than a hundred hours of audio data. This includes recording various types of meetings, such as those with political discussions, debates, and other natural interactions, as well as exploring opportunities with radio and television shows to obtain multi-channel recordings. The goal is to gather enough data to support research, even if some of it is not transcribed, and to ensure that the data collected is diverse and representative of real-world interactions.
full.measured_scope: physical node KV storage; eager gather temporaries excluded, no latency claim
